name: hit_flesh
for: a cut or blow landing on a living body (hero hurt, husk, lancer, wretch, hound, bandits, flesh bosses)
notes: Dark near-black red blood: a short ragged burst at the wound, droplets and a few heavy gobbets spraying toward +x (away from the blow), falling and spattering on the floor 74 px (1.17 m) below the anchor, plus a fine red mist that hangs and fades. No cartoon splat or star. Mirror x for blows from the right. 12 frames @ 12 fps.
